join.title: Join a house
join.name: Name
join.addToHomeTitle: Please add this app to your home screen
join.addToHomeBody: On iPhone, use Safari's share button to "Add to Home Screen", then open it from that icon before joining.
join.openedFromBrowser: This page was opened from a browser
join.createHouseLink: Setting up a house as a representative? Click here
join.handoverLink: Got a new phone or reinstalled the app? Click here

handover.title: Return with a handover code
handover.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit handover code (valid for 24 hours) issued from Settings.

errors.invalid_or_expired_code: This code is invalid or has expired.
errors.member_not_found_or_left: That member could not be found (they may have already left).
errors.owner_count_would_drop_below_two: There must always be at least 2 representatives, so this member can't leave. Make someone else a representative first.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.code_not_found: This invite code was not found. Please check the number again.
errors.code_already_used: This invite code has already been used. Ask a representative for a new one.
errors.code_expired: This invite code has expired. Ask a representative for a new one.
errors.room_already_occupied: Someone has already joined with this room number.
errors.invalid_room_number: That room number is not valid.
errors.issue_failed: The code could not be issued. Please try again.
errors.invalid_room_numbers: Please check the room numbers (a number appears twice, or none was entered).

createHouse.title: Create a new house
createHouse.subtitle: You'll become a representative. In case you can no longer log in, make someone who joins a representative from Settings later (two or more is recommended).
createHouse.roomNumbers: Room numbers in your unit (all rooms)
createHouse.roomNumbersHint: These are the rooms in your unit (including empty rooms). Correct them if needed, and clear any box you don't use.
createHouse.unitNumberHint: Enter something like 110 and the room numbers (111, 112, …) are filled in for you. You can correct them below.

home.expectedEndTimeHint: If left blank, it will default to {minutes} minutes after starting

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsNeedsHomeScreen: To receive notifications, use Safari's share button to "Add to Home Screen" and reopen from that icon.
settings.inviteHint: A 6-digit code will be shown once issued (valid for 7 days).
settings.handoverHint: Issue a 6-digit handover code (valid for 24 hours) to use when you get a new phone or reinstall the app.
settings.recoveryHint: If this person can no longer log in, issue a 6-digit recovery code and tell it to them (valid for 24 hours). They can enter it from "Got a new phone or reinstalled the app?" on the join screen.
settings.makeOwnerHint: Representatives can issue invite and recovery codes and handle move-outs. Keep at least two, in case one can no longer log in.
